column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the abomination desolating” is rendered “the abomination of desolation,” and “the perpetual [offering]” “the daily sacrifices.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will display strength and act” is rendered “shall be strong, and carry out great exploits,” adding “great exploits.”
Close to the Hebrew; “days” is rendered “for many days.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to purge and to purify” is rendered “purify them, and make them white.”
Close to the Hebrew; “extraordinary things” is rendered “blasphemies,” and “the indignation” “the wrath.”
NKJV renders the plural “the gods of his fathers” as singular, “the God of his fathers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “precious things” is rendered “pleasant things.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for a price” is rendered “for gain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will storm against him” is rendered “shall come against him like a whirlwind.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “countries” (“many countries shall be overthrown”), and renders “the first of the people of Ammon” “the prominent people of Ammon.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Cushites” is rendered “Ethiopians.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mountain of the beauty of holiness” is rendered “the glorious holy mountain.”
